prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing a black crop top and black pants with a thick yellow-green stripe down the outer leg"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06"].

message.content: {"matches":["P04"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"Only P04 wears a black crop top and black pants with a thick yellow-green stripe down the outer leg, visible in both crops. Other individuals either wear different tops (e.g., white or patterned crop tops) or pants without the specified stripe (e.g., P01 has plain black pants, P06 has white stripes)."}

parsed.reason: Only P04 wears a black crop top and black pants with a thick yellow-green stripe down the outer leg, visible in both crops. Other individuals either wear different tops (e.g., white or patterned crop tops) or pants without the specified stripe (e.g., P01 has plain black pants, P06 has white stripes).
